columns.name: tagline
columns.label: Headline
columns.help: One short line on the home page, e.g. See a doctor today, no appointment.

columns.name: tagline_accent
columns.label: Headline's second line
columns.help: Boutique font: shown under the headline in a lighter green, e.g. Skip the waiting room.

columns.name: label
columns.label: Small line under the name
columns.help: Boutique font: under the clinic name in the header, e.g. Family clinic, Al Barsha.

columns.name: intro
columns.label: Short line under the headline
columns.help: One or two sentences, e.g. what you treat and for whom.

columns.name: logo
columns.label: Logo
columns.help: Optional. A wide logo on a transparent or white background; it replaces the clinic name in the header and on the waiting-room screen.

columns.name: hero_image
columns.label: Banner photo
columns.help: Optional. The main photo of your home page, e.g. your reception or waiting room. heritage, atelier: fills the screen behind the headline (wide, 2000 px).

columns.name: story
columns.label: About the clinic
columns.help: Optional. One or two sentences about who you are, shown on the home page.

columns.name: story_image
columns.label: Second photo
columns.help: Optional. Shown with the About text, e.g. a treatment room. Wide photos work best.

columns.name: interior_image
columns.label: Photo of your place
columns.help: Optional, boutique font: next to the opening hours, e.g. your reception or waiting area.

columns.name: brand_color
columns.label: Brand colour
columns.help: Your main colour as a hex code, e.g. #2D5A87 for calm blue or #1F4D3A for palm green. Buttons, the screen and the tickets use it; text on it turns white or dark by itself.

columns.name: font
columns.label: Font
columns.help: modern: clean. classic: serif headings. rounded: friendly. heritage: Arabian luxury, ivory and gold. atelier: modern luxury in black and white (both: luxury layout). boutique: calm and modern, ticket-shaped photos, the live queue on the home page. All have Arabic.

columns.name: phone
columns.label: Phone number
columns.help: Shown on the home page, e.g. +971 4 123 4567.

columns.name: whatsapp
columns.label: WhatsApp number
columns.help: Optional. International format, e.g. +971501234567, for the Message us button.

columns.name: opens
columns.label: Opens at
columns.help: 24-hour time, e.g. 08:00. Numbers can be taken from this time.

columns.name: closes
columns.label: Closes at
columns.help: 24-hour time on the same day, e.g. 22:00.

columns.name: closed_days
columns.label: Closed days
columns.help: Weekdays without a queue as numbers separated by commas: 0 Sunday, 1 Monday, 2 Tuesday, 3 Wednesday, 4 Thursday, 5 Friday, 6 Saturday. Leave empty when open every day.

columns.name: last_ticket_minutes
columns.label: Last number before closing (minutes)
columns.help: No new numbers this many minutes before closing, e.g. 30. 0: until closing time.

columns.name: avg_minutes
columns.label: Average minutes per patient
columns.help: Used for the estimated wait when a service has no minutes of its own, e.g. 12.

columns.name: notify_ahead
columns.label: Tell the patient when this many are ahead
columns.help: e.g. 2: one message when two patients are ahead of them. 0 turns the messages off.

columns.name: whatsapp_alerts
columns.label: Send that message on WhatsApp
columns.help: Each message counts towards your plan's monthly WhatsApp messages; when they are used up, patients with an email get an email instead.

columns.name: daily_limit
columns.label: Most numbers per day
columns.help: Optional. Stop taking numbers after this many in one day. 0 or empty: no limit.

columns.name: keep_contact_days
columns.label: Keep patients' names and numbers (days)
columns.help: Older tickets keep only the counts for your reports; names, mobile numbers and emails are wiped every night. Empty: 30 days. 0: wiped the same night.

columns.name: ticket_note
columns.label: Note on the patient's ticket
columns.help: Optional, e.g. Please have your Emirates ID or insurance card ready at reception.

columns.name: screen_note
columns.label: Line on the waiting-room screen
columns.help: Optional, e.g. Free Wi-Fi: ClinicGuest.

columns.name: name
columns.label: Service
columns.help: What patients choose, e.g. General practice, Dental check-up, a doctor's name.

columns.name: detail
columns.label: Who sees them
columns.help: One short line, e.g. Family doctors on duty.

columns.name: description
columns.label: Description
columns.help: Optional. One or two sentences on the take-a-number page.

columns.name: prefix
columns.label: Ticket letter
columns.help: The letter before the numbers, e.g. A gives A001, A002. One letter per service.

columns.name: minutes
columns.label: Minutes per patient
columns.help: Optional. Empty uses the clinic's average.

columns.name: desks
columns.label: Seen at the same time
columns.help: How many doctors or rooms see these patients at once, e.g. 2. The estimated wait is divided by it.

columns.name: icon
columns.label: Icon
columns.help: Shown on the service card when it has no photo.

columns.name: image
columns.label: Photo
columns.help: Optional. A small round photo on the service card, instead of the icon.

columns.name: active
columns.label: Offered
columns.help: Untick to stop taking numbers for it.

columns.name: position
columns.label: Order
columns.help: Lower numbers come first.

columns.name: name
columns.label: Room
columns.help: As patients see it on the screen, e.g. Room 2 or Counter 1.

columns.name: who
columns.label: Who works here
columns.help: Optional, e.g. Dr. Sara.

columns.name: services
columns.label: Services it calls
columns.help: The ticket letters this room calls, e.g. A or A, D. Empty: every service.

columns.name: active
columns.label: Open
columns.help: Untick when the room is closed today.

columns.name: status
columns.label: Status
columns.help: Set to called to call the patient to the room below (the screens update at once), then done or no_show.

columns.name: room_id
columns.label: Room
columns.help: Set when the patient is called; empty picks the first room that sees the service.

columns.name: day
columns.label: Day
columns.help: UAE date, YYYY-MM-DD.

columns.name: token
columns.label: Ticket link key
columns.help: The secret part of the patient's ticket link; do not change it.

columns.name: alerted
columns.label: Told their turn is close
columns.help: whatsapp, email, both, near (joined close to their turn) or failed.

columns.name: email
columns.label: Email
columns.help: The email a staff member signs in with on the clinic's site; they then open /staff to call patients. * lets anyone signed in, only for trying it out.

columns.name: quote
columns.label: What they said
columns.help: A real review from a patient, in their words.

columns.name: name
columns.label: Name
columns.help: As the patient agreed, e.g. Sara M.

columns.name: area
columns.label: Visit or area
columns.help: Optional, e.g. Physiotherapy.

clinic.name: Shifa Family Clinic
clinic.label: Family clinic, Al Barsha
clinic.intro: Walk in, take a number on your phone and wait where you like. We message you on WhatsApp when two patients are ahead of you.
clinic.intro_ar: تعال، احصل على رقم من هاتفك وانتظر حيث تشاء. نرسل لك رسالة على واتساب عندما يكون قبلك مريضان.
clinic.story: A family clinic in Al Barsha since 2011: general practice, dental care, physiotherapy and a nurse for blood tests and vaccines, open every day.
clinic.story_ar: عيادة عائلية في البرشاء منذ 2011: طب عام وأسنان وعلاج طبيعي وممرضة لتحاليل الدم والتطعيمات، مفتوحة كل يوم.
clinic.address: Ground floor, Al Barsha Mall annex, Al Barsha 1, Dubai
clinic.address_ar: الطابق الأرضي، ملحق البرشاء مول، البرشاء 1، دبي
clinic.ticket_note: Please have your Emirates ID or insurance card ready at reception.
clinic.ticket_note_ar: يُرجى تجهيز الهوية الإماراتية أو بطاقة التأمين عند الاستقبال.

services.name: General practice
services.description: Fever, cough, a check-up, sick leave or a referral. For adults and children.
services.description_ar: حمّى أو سعال أو فحص عام أو إجازة مرضية أو تحويل. للكبار والأطفال.

services.name: Dental
services.description: Toothache, a check-up or a cleaning.
services.description_ar: ألم في الأسنان أو فحص أو تنظيف.

services.name: Physiotherapy
services.description: Back, neck and sports injuries; bring your referral if you have one.
services.description_ar: آلام الظهر والرقبة وإصابات الرياضة؛ أحضر التحويل إن وُجد.

services.name: Blood tests and vaccines
services.description: With a doctor's request. Results by email.
services.description_ar: بطلب من الطبيب. النتائج بالبريد الإلكتروني.

texts.en: Pick the service or doctor you came for. You get a number and see your place in the queue on your phone.
texts.ar: اختر الخدمة أو الطبيب الذي جئت من أجله. تحصل على رقم وترى دورك في الطابور على هاتفك.

texts.en: No more numbers today. We open again tomorrow at {opens}.
texts.ar: انتهت أرقام اليوم. نفتح غداً في {opens}.

texts.en: Today's numbers are all taken. Please come back tomorrow.
texts.ar: نفدت أرقام اليوم. عُد غداً من فضلك.

texts.en: Taking numbers now, day and night

texts.ar: عيادة بلا موعد، مفتوحة كل يوم

texts.en: No appointment, no app. Your place in the queue in seconds.
texts.ar: بلا موعد وبلا تطبيق. دورك في الطابور خلال ثوانٍ.

texts.en: Your mobile is used for one WhatsApp message when your turn is close.
texts.ar: نستخدم رقمك لرسالة واحدة على واتساب عندما يقترب دورك.

texts.en: Your mobile is only for the clinic to reach you.
texts.ar: رقمك فقط لتتمكن العيادة من التواصل معك.

texts.en: Walk in and take a number
When {n} patients are ahead of you
When 1 patient is ahead of you
Follow your number on your phone
Scan the code at reception or open this page, choose the service and type your name and mobile.
texts.ar: امسح الرمز عند الاستقبال أو افتح هذه الصفحة، واختر الخدمة واكتب اسمك ورقم هاتفك.

texts.en: Your phone shows how many are ahead of you, and we message you when your turn is close.
texts.ar: يُظهر هاتفك عدد من قبلك، ونرسل لك رسالة عندما يقترب دورك.

texts.en: Your phone shows how many are ahead of you and the estimated wait, live.
texts.ar: يُظهر هاتفك عدد من قبلك والانتظار المتوقع مباشرة.

texts.en: When we call your number, the screen and your phone show which room to go to.
texts.ar: عندما نُنادي رقمك، تُظهر الشاشة وهاتفك الغرفة التي تتوجه إليها.

texts.en: No. Take a number when you arrive, on your phone or at the reception tablet, and we see patients in the order they came.
texts.ar: لا. احصل على رقم عند وصولك، من هاتفك أو من جهاز الاستقبال، ونستقبل المرضى بترتيب وصولهم.

texts.en: How is the wait worked out?
From the patients ahead of you and about {m} minutes per patient. It changes as the queue moves, so keep the page open.
texts.ar: من عدد المرضى قبلك ونحو {m} دقيقة لكل مريض. يتغير مع حركة الطابور، فأبقِ الصفحة مفتوحة.

texts.en: Yes. We send you one WhatsApp message when {n} patients are ahead of you, so you have time to come back.
texts.ar: نعم. نرسل لك رسالة واحدة على واتساب عندما يكون قبلك {n} مرضى، فيكون لديك وقت للعودة.

texts.en: Yes. If you give your email we write to you when {n} patients are ahead of you, so you have time to come back.
texts.ar: نعم. إذا كتبت بريدك الإلكتروني نراسلك عندما يكون قبلك {n} مرضى، فيكون لديك وقت للعودة.

texts.en: What if I miss my turn?
Tell the reception. They can put your number back in the queue.
texts.ar: أخبر الاستقبال، ويمكنهم إعادة رقمك إلى الطابور.

texts.en: Until when can I take a number?
For one WhatsApp message when your turn is close. We never share it.
texts.ar: لرسالة واحدة على واتساب عندما يقترب دورك. لا نشاركه مع أحد.

texts.en: So the reception can reach you. We never share it.
texts.ar: ليتمكن الاستقبال من التواصل معك. لا نشاركه مع أحد.

texts.en: We send you one WhatsApp message (and an email, if you give one) when {n} patients are ahead of you.
texts.ar: نرسل لك رسالة واحدة على واتساب (وبريداً إلكترونياً إن كتبته) عندما يكون قبلك {n} مرضى.

texts.en: If you give your email, we write to you when {n} patients are ahead of you.
texts.ar: إذا كتبت بريدك الإلكتروني نراسلك عندما يكون قبلك {n} مرضى.

texts.en: Keep your ticket page open to see your place in the queue.
texts.ar: أبقِ صفحة تذكرتك مفتوحة لترى دورك في الطابور.

texts.en: Your number is on the screen now.
This ticket is from an earlier day.
I cannot wait, leave the queue
Leave the queue? Your number goes to the next patient.
texts.ar: هل تريد ترك الطابور؟ سيذهب دورك إلى المريض التالي.

texts.en: Seen. Thank you for your visit.

texts.ar: فات الدور (لم يكن حاضراً عند النداء)

texts.en: The day ended before your turn
The link may be cut short, or the ticket is from long ago. Take a new number.
texts.ar: ربما الرابط ناقص أو التذكرة قديمة. احصل على رقم جديد.

texts.en: Open the link on the phone you took your number with: it is in your browser and in the WhatsApp message we send. No number yet? Take one below.
texts.ar: افتح الرابط على الهاتف الذي أخذت به رقمك: تجده في المتصفح وفي رسالة واتساب التي نرسلها. لا رقم لديك بعد؟ احصل على رقم من الزر أدناه.

texts.en: This page does not exist or the service is no longer offered.
texts.ar: هذه الصفحة غير موجودة أو الخدمة لم تعد متاحة.

texts.en: Type your mobile number, for example 050 123 4567.
Check the email address, or leave it empty.
texts.ar: تحقق من البريد الإلكتروني أو اتركه فارغاً.

texts.en: Numbers have not started yet today.
This mobile number already has a number in today's queue. Open the link on that phone, or ask at reception.
texts.ar: لهذا الرقم دور في طابور اليوم. افتح الرابط على ذلك الهاتف أو اسأل الاستقبال.

texts.en: That ticket has already moved on.
Ticket {code}: {n} patients are ahead of you, {wait}. Please come back to the waiting room.
texts.ar: التذكرة {code}: قبلك {n} مرضى، {wait}. نرجو العودة إلى قاعة الانتظار.

texts.en: Ticket {code}: 1 patient is ahead of you. Please come back to the waiting room.
texts.ar: التذكرة {code}: قبلك مريض واحد. نرجو العودة إلى قاعة الانتظار.

texts.en: Ticket {code}: you are next. Please come to the waiting room.
texts.ar: التذكرة {code}: أنت التالي. نرجو الحضور إلى قاعة الانتظار.

texts.en: Scan to follow your place on your phone
texts.ar: امسح الرمز لتتابع دورك على هاتفك

texts.en: Tap your service, then type your name and mobile number.
texts.ar: اختر خدمتك ثم اكتب اسمك ورقم جوالك.

texts.en: Please take a seat. Your number appears on the screen when it is your turn.
texts.ar: تفضّل بالجلوس. سيظهر رقمك على الشاشة عندما يحين دورك.

texts.en: This account is not on the clinic's staff list. Ask the owner to add your email in the admin panel (table Staff page access).
texts.ar: هذا الحساب ليس في قائمة موظفي العيادة. اطلب من المالك إضافة بريدك في لوحة التحكم (جدول صلاحية صفحة الموظفين).

texts.en: Sign in with the email the clinic added to its staff list.
texts.ar: سجّل الدخول بالبريد الذي أضافته العيادة إلى قائمة الموظفين.

texts.en: Add your rooms in the admin panel (table Rooms) to call patients.
texts.ar: أضف غرفك في لوحة التحكم (جدول الغرف) لتنادي المرضى.

texts.en: The last 14 days, from the queue's own records.
Nothing to pay here: numbers are free.
texts.ar: لا شيء للدفع هنا: الأرقام مجانية.

templates.css:
<style>
[hidden]{display:none!important}
/* Renoxium template design system: shared base. The theme (brand colour, font, logo) comes from theme() in lib and sits on <html>. */
:root{color-scheme:light;--brand:#334155;--on-brand:#fff;--brand-text:#334155;
--paper:#fff;--ink:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 14%,#121212);--ink-2:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ink) 74%,#fff);
--line:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ink) 12%,#fff);--line-strong:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ink) 28%,#fff);
--well:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 5%,#f4f3f1);--brand-soft:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 8%,#fff);
--brand-hover:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 84%,#000);--danger:#a3261d;--danger-soft:#fbeeec;
--r-control:8px;--r-media:4px;--r-sheet:12px;
--fs-14:.875rem;--fs-16:1rem;--fs-18:1.125rem;--fs-22:1.375rem;--fs-28:1.75rem;--fs-36:2.25rem;--fs-48:3rem;
--font-text:"IBM Plex Sans","IBM Plex Sans Arabic",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Tahoma,sans-serif;--font-display:var(--font-text);--display-boost:1}
[data-font=classic]{--font-display:"Markazi Text","Noto Naskh Arabic",Georgia,serif;--display-boost:1.16}
[data-font=rounded]{--font-text:"Rubik",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Tahoma,sans-serif}
/* Luxury type pairs (font = heritage or atelier; theme() then sets data-style=luxury). Arabic falls through to the Arabic face. */
[data-font=heritage]{--paper:#fbf8f2;--well:#f0eadf;--accent:#a08048;--font-display:"Cormorant Garamond","Amiri",Georgia,serif;--font-text:"Jost","Noto Naskh Arabic",system-ui,sans-serif}
[data-font=atelier]{--paper:#fff;--well:#f3f2ef;--accent:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ink) 40%,#fff);--font-display:"Bodoni Moda","Noto Naskh Arabic",Didot,Georgia,serif;--font-text:"Hanken Grotesk","Noto Kufi Arabic",system-ui,sans-serif}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-text);font-size:var(--fs-16);line-height:1.55;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-wrap:break-word}
body:lang(ar){line-height:1.75}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
h1,h2,h3{margin:0;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);text-wrap:balance}
h1,h2{font-family:var(--font-display)}
h1{font-size:calc(var(--fs-28) * var(--display-boost));line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.015em}
h2{font-size:calc(var(--fs-22) * var(--display-boost));line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.01em}
h3{font-size:var(--fs-18);line-height:1.35}
h1:lang(ar),h2:lang(ar),h3:lang(ar){letter-spacing:0;line-height:1.45}
@media(min-width:720px){h1{font-size:calc(var(--fs-36) * var(--display-boost))}}
p{margin:0}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:.22em}
a:hover{color:var(--brand-text)}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--brand-text);outline-offset:2px}
.num,.price{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums}
.price{white-space:nowrap}
.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
.small{font-size:var(--fs-14)}.quiet{color:var(--ink-2)}
.wrap{--gutter:16px;max-width:1180px;margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:var(--gutter)}
@media(min-width:720px){.wrap{--gutter:24px}}
@media(min-width:1080px){.wrap{--gutter:32px}}
.skip{position:absolute;inset-inline-start:-9999px;top:8px}.skip:focus{inset-inline-start:16px;z-index:50;background:var(--paper);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:var(--r-control)}

/* Top bar, header, footer */
.bar{background:var(--well);font-size:var(--fs-14);color:var(--ink-2)}
.bar .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px 16px;min-height:36px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.langs{display:flex;align-items:center}
.langs a{text-decoration:none;padding:6px 0;color:var(--ink-2)}
.langs a+a{margin-inline-start:12px;padding-inline-start:12px;border-inline-start:1px solid var(--line-strong)}
.langs a[aria-current]{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
.site-head{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;background:var(--paper);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.site-head .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;min-height:64px}
.mark{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:600;font-size:calc(var(--fs-22) * var(--display-boost));line-height:1.2;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink)}
.mark img{max-height:40px;width:auto}
.acts{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;font-size:var(--fs-16)}
.acts a{text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:44px}
.acts a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.count{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:22px;height:22px;padding-inline:6px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--brand);color:var(--on-brand);font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1}
.count[hidden]{display:none}
.site-foot{margin-top:72px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:var(--fs-14);color:var(--ink-2)}
.site-foot .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px 40px;padding-block:32px 40px}
.site-foot strong{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-weight:500;font-size:var(--fs-16)}
.foot-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px 24px}
.foot-links form{margin:0}

/* Page heads, buttons, notices */
.page-head{padding-block:32px 24px}
.page-head p{margin-top:8px;color:var(--ink-2)}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:48px;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:var(--r-control);border:1px solid transparent;font:inherit;font-weight:500;line-height:1.2;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;background:var(--brand);color:var(--on-brand)}
.btn:hover{background:var(--brand-hover);color:var(--on-brand)}
.btn.line{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--line-strong)}
.btn.line:hover{border-color:var(--ink);background:transparent;color:var(--ink)}
.btn.wide{width:100%}

<style>
/* Motion kit: one easing and three durations; only transform and opacity move, so nothing reflows and layout never shifts.
   Everything here is off with prefers-reduced-motion. Elements on screen at load never wait for an animation. */
:root{--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);--t-fast:.18s;--t-mid:.35s;--t-slow:.7s}
/* List to detail: the card's photo frame and the detail page's frame share a view-transition-name (inline style, unique in the page).
   A card with a photo names its photo frame, a card without one names its title; never both.
   The name goes on the element that carries the mask (border-radius with overflow, or clip-path), never on a photo inside it:
   only then does the snapshot keep the shape. Both snapshots fill the moving box and crop like object-fit:cover, so a photo
   never stretches; the header keeps its place above the photo that moves. */
@view-transition{navigation:auto}
::view-transition-old(root),::view-transition-new(root){animation-duration:.26s}
::view-transition-group(*){animation-duration:.42s;animation-timing-function:var(--ease-out)}
::view-transition-old(*),::view-transition-new(*){width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
/* A card without a photo: its title moves into the page's h1 instead (class vtt on a box that hugs the text). Text is never
   cropped: its snapshots keep their own proportions and scale with the box, and the old words are gone before the new ones
   are fully there, so two sizes or two line breaks are never read at once. */
.vtt{display:inline-block;max-width:100%;text-decoration:inherit;view-transition-class:vtt}
::view-transition-old(.vtt),::view-transition-new(.vtt){height:auto;object-fit:fill}
::view-transition-old(.vtt){animation-duration:.16s}::view-transition-new(.vtt){animation-delay:.12s;animation-duration:.3s}

<script>
/* The queue, live: every page that shows it listens to the public channel public:queue (codes, rooms and counts only).
   Without EventSource, or while the stream is down, it asks /api/queue every 20 seconds. Messages from another day are
   ignored, so yesterday's last message never shows on a new morning. */
window.rxQueue=function(day,cb,state){var es,timer,last=0;
function use(d){if(!d||d.day!==day)return;last=Date.now();try{cb(d)}catch(e){}if(state)state(true)}
function poll(){fetch('/api/queue',{cache:'no-store'}).then(function(r){return r.json()}).then(use).catch(function(){if(state)state(false)})}
function slow(){if(!timer)timer=setInterval(function(){if(Date.now()-last>15000)poll()},20000)}
if(window.EventSource){es=new EventSource('/_rx/live/public:queue');es.onmessage=function(e){try{use(JSON.parse(e.data))}catch(x){}};es.onerror=function(){if(state)state(false);slow()};es.onopen=function(){if(state)state(true)}}
slow();document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){if(!document.hidden)poll()});};
window.rxWait=function(ahead,m,d,t){var w=ahead>0?Math.ceil(ahead*m/Math.max(1,d)):0;if(w<=0)return t.none;if(w<60)return t.min.replace('{n}',w);return t.hours.replace('{h}',Math.floor(w/60)).replace('{m}',w%60)};
</script>
